source.scope: Occupational context for equipment, ingredients, and supervised preparation. This overview does not verify every proposed term or provide operating instructions.

source.title: Food and Beverage Serving and Related Workers
source.scope: Occupational context for greetings, orders, payment, table service, and team roles. Job titles and responsibilities vary by establishment and region.

source.title: Food Code 2026
source.scope: The introduction was consulted for retail food-service control context. The full PDF and standards text were not acquired or copied. Term-level verification, local adoption, and food-safety review remain pending.

source.title: Allergen guidance for food businesses
source.scope: Publication landing page, updated 17 July 2026, consulted. It applies to England, Northern Ireland, and Wales. The linked full HTML guidance was not successfully retrieved; this reference is context, not full term verification or guidance for other jurisdictions.

source.title: HACCP Principles & Application Guidelines
source.scope: Definitions consulted for HACCP, critical control point, and corrective action. The underlying guidelines were adopted 14 August 1997; they are historical conceptual context, not approval of a current local plan. No implementation steps are copied.

source.title: Customer Service Representatives
source.scope: Occupational context for account questions, orders, billing, complaints, records, and referrals across communication channels. Duties vary by industry; specialized finance and insurance work can require additional authorization. This is not term-level review.

source.title: 43-4051.00 - Customer Service Representatives
source.scope: The 2026 occupation page was consulted for communication, recordkeeping, billing, complaint referral, and work coordination. Its classification excludes roles primarily devoted to technical support, repair, installation, or sales. This course covers frontline issue communication rather than technical repair training.

source.title: About the ticket lifecycle and ticket statuses
source.scope: Product-specific context for case statuses, ownership, reopening, and follow-up tickets. The source distinguishes solved from closed and explains system-controlled closure. Its labels, transitions, and timers are not universal workflow rules; no vendor interface or illustration is copied.

source.title: About native Support time duration metrics
source.scope: Product-specific context for first reply, resolution, and waiting intervals. Native metrics and SLA metrics can use different behavior despite identical names. Counts, start/end events, exclusions, business hours, and other measures require explicit local definitions.

source.title: Principle (c): Data minimisation
source.scope: UK data-protection context for sufficient, relevant, purpose-limited information. The page explicitly says it is under review following the Data (Use and Access) Act and may change. It is not current jurisdiction-wide legal sign-off; no retention deadline, lawful basis, or exception is prescribed.

source.title: How To Spot, Avoid, and Report Tech Support Scams
source.scope: Context for impersonation, pressure, remote-access requests, and fake service or refund claims. The draft teaches reporting and approved contact routes, not scam scripts, credential collection, incident-response techniques, or universal payment-reversal rights.

source.title: Principles of good complaint handling
source.scope: The overview of complaint-handling principles was consulted for respectful, fair, accountable responses and improvement. It is public-service context, not a universal commercial complaint procedure or entitlement; detailed linked chapters were not consulted.

source.title: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants
source.scope: Occupational context for schedules, correspondence, records, office tools, supplies, and varied administrative roles. Legal, medical, and executive specialties have distinct preparation and responsibilities. No employment count is used as a curriculum-frequency claim, and this overview is not term-level review.

source.title: 43-6014.00 - Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
source.scope: The occupation-specific task overview was consulted for files, messages, calendars, meetings, documents, supplies, and travel coordination. The classification explicitly excludes legal, medical, and executive specialties; their titles are recognition vocabulary, not a combined qualification. Listed tasks are not universal permissions or a word-frequency ranking.

source.title: 43-9061.00 - Office Clerks, General
source.scope: The task overview was consulted for filing, typing, proofreading, mail, calendars, expense records, and minutes. Activities vary by workplace and authority. No equipment repair, cash handling, or financial procedure is copied into the language lessons.

source.title: Scheduling Records
source.publisher: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
source.scope: Context for records categories, retention, authorized disposition, scope, and superseded schedules. The page concerns U.S. federal records; its legal rules and periods are not universal office requirements. No retention period, disposal instruction, or automatic permission is adopted. Current local schedules, holds, and authorized review still apply.

source.title: Making Events Accessible
source.scope: Context for individual access requirements, accessible venues and platforms, materials in advance, captions, and participation in remote, in-person, and hybrid events. Screen sharing alone may not provide accessible content. The page displayed an update date of 31 August 2022; consultation is not a compliance certification or review of a specific event.

source.title: eTools: Computer Workstations
source.scope: The overview was consulted for workstation vocabulary and the need to fit work to individual people. It says no single arrangement fits everyone and that eTools do not create new OSHA requirements. No posture prescription, numeric setup, equipment-use method, emergency procedure, or legal compliance conclusion is taught. Linked detailed component pages were not consulted.

source.title: Hand Laborers and Material Movers
source.scope: Broad occupational context for manual movement, packing, stock, and order-filling work. The group includes occupations outside warehousing; its employment total is not the population of one warehouse role or a vocabulary-frequency ranking. No lifting, cleaning, machine-feeding, repair, or driving procedure is adopted.

source.title: Material Recording Clerks
source.scope: Occupational overview consulted for shipment and movement records, inventory accuracy, production coordination, and discrepancies. Titles, duties, and actual authority vary by workplace. This is contextual research, not term-level or specialist approval.

source.title: 53-7065.00 - Stockers and Order Fillers
source.scope: The task overview was consulted for receiving, counting, stock locations, records, and order preparation. Listed equipment activities do not authorize a learner to operate the equipment. No task procedure, qualification, or curriculum-frequency ranking is adopted.

source.title: 43-5071.00 - Shipping, Receiving, and Inventory Clerks
source.scope: The task overview was consulted for incoming and outgoing records, comparisons with shipment contents, inventory records, and carrier coordination. No shipping-law rule, tariff, demurrage requirement, freight calculation, or operational procedure is taught.

source.title: Warehousing
source.scope: The overview was consulted for powered industrial trucks, ergonomics, materials handling, chemicals, slip/trip/fall, and robotics concerns. The page describes an updated National Emphasis Program with inspections beginning 31 July 2026; this is U.S. program context, not a universal site requirement. Linked standards and detailed hazard pages were not consulted. No equipment method, lifting technique, load calculation, emergency sequence, or energy-isolation procedure is adopted.

source.title: Warehousing
source.scope: The warehousing overview was consulted for vehicle and pedestrian separation, visitors and visiting drivers, local responsibilities, communication, and manual-handling concerns. This is UK guidance context. No route dimensions, lifting technique, docking sequence, load limits, equipment methods, or emergency steps are taught. Detailed linked publications were not acquired.

source.title: Lodging Managers
source.scope: Occupational context consulted for lodging services, varied property types, reservations, guest questions, and departmental coordination. This management occupation is not a population estimate for all hospitality workers or a vocabulary-frequency ranking. No financial procedure or universal job authority is adopted.

source.title: Travel Agents
source.scope: Occupational context consulted for planning, schedules, bookings, itineraries, outings, and traveler preferences. No visa, entry-eligibility, insurance-coverage, travel-health, or binding consumer-rights decision is taught.

source.title: 43-4081.00 - Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
source.scope: Task list consulted for arrival, reservations, room assignment, guest accounts, housekeeping coordination, complaints, and records. Listed financial, identification, and key-issuing activities do not establish worker authorization or a universal process.

source.title: VisitEngland Accessible and Inclusive Tourism Toolkit
source.scope: Overview consulted for individual access requirements, inclusive communication, accurate feature information, and continued improvement. The overview states that the toolkit is regularly reviewed. Detailed sections, Word files, PDFs, checklists, and technical design guidance were not acquired or reviewed. No construction dimension or legal-compliance claim is adopted.

source.title: Getting started in catering and hospitality
source.scope: Introductory hospitality safety page consulted for responsibility, risk management, and identifying applicable requirements. UK context only; linked detailed law and work-activity pages were not reviewed. No cleaning, chemical, lifting, fire, gas, electrical, or emergency technique is taught.

source.title: ADA Guide for Places of Lodging: Serving Guests Who Are Blind or Who Have Low Vision
source.scope: Selected passages consulted for offering assistance, respecting responses, accessible formats, privacy when reviewing bills, and staff training. The page states that it was originally issued on 1 January 2001 and updated on 24 February 2020, and that guidance adds no independent enforceable obligations. U.S. context for blind guests or guests with low vision; not universal accessibility or current legal certification. Guiding techniques, building specifications, tax provisions, and numerical requirements are not adopted.

source.title: Delivery Truck Drivers and Driver/Sales Workers
source.scope: Occupational duties and work-context passages consulted for route planning, customer communication, incident reporting, vehicle concerns, and delivery records. This occupational overview is not a vocabulary-frequency ranking, term dictionary, training authorization, or universal procedure. No employment statistic, qualification threshold, or driving technique is adopted.

source.title: 43-5021.00 - Couriers and Messengers
source.scope: Task and work-activity passages consulted for collection, sorting, delivery details, route planning, records, signatures, and communication with offices. Listed tasks do not grant permission or establish competence. Medical transport, hazardous goods, maintenance, and payment procedures are outside this language draft.

source.title: Carry out van daily walkaround checks
source.publisher: UK Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency
source.scope: HTML sections consulted for vehicle-part vocabulary and the distinction between checking, recording, and reporting defects. The page applies to England, Scotland, and Wales. Linked diagrams and detailed load-securing guidance were not acquired. No technical inspection method, target pressure, tread depth, penalty, or legal compliance assertion is taught.

source.title: Loading
source.scope: Loading-area, vehicle, equipment, load stability, and coordination passages consulted as occupational safety context. The language draft names concerns and requests the applicable plan; it does not teach loading, lifting, restraint selection, operation, or release procedures. Source artwork was not acquired.

source.title: The Highway Code: General rules, techniques and advice for all drivers and riders (103 to 158)
source.scope: Selected road-layout, lane, visibility, restriction, and in-vehicle-distraction passages consulted. UK-specific rules are not generalized to other jurisdictions. This draft teaches road-feature names and communication, not speed limits, priority rules, permitted maneuvers, parking entitlements, or emergency procedures. No diagrams were acquired.

source.title: What Does My UPS Tracking Status Mean?
source.scope: Status explanations consulted to distinguish scan information, dispatch for delivery, completion, and exceptions. This is one carrier and region, not a universal workflow. Published time windows, unattended-placement practices, automatic attempts, and service promises are not adopted.

source.title: UPS Tracking Support
source.scope: Selected delivery-notice and delivery-photo passages consulted for records associated with a delivery event. Carrier and region-specific context only; a photograph is not represented as conclusive proof of identity, acceptance, or contractual completion. Tracking formats, timings, redelivery promises, link-safety shortcuts, and unattended placement procedures are not adopted.

source.title: Redelivery - The Basics
source.scope: Redelivery, notice, locker, recipient availability, and signature passages consulted as service-specific vocabulary context. Eligibility and procedures vary by item, service, and location. No authorization assumption, signature substitute, deadline, fee, or redelivery entitlement is taught. Forms and images were not acquired.

source.title: GPS
source.scope: Overview consulted for the Global Positioning System and its positioning, navigation, and timing functions. GPS is distinguished from an application, route planner, map database, and guaranteed delivery address. No accuracy guarantee or technical operating procedure is adopted.

source.title: Vulnerability
source.scope: Actual glossary definitions consulted by the independent reviewer on 2026-10-16 for the distinction between a weakness and a threat that can exploit or trigger it. Linked standards were not reviewed in full. This targeted clarification does not certify the whole security vocabulary or a professional procedure.

source.title: Computer Support Specialists
source.scope: Role and duties consulted for user assistance, network maintenance, equipment setup, diagnosis, documentation, training, and escalation. Occupational context only; no vocabulary-frequency ranking or independent authorization to repair equipment is inferred.

source.title: 15-1232.00 - Computer User Support Specialists
source.scope: Occupation overview and task list consulted for user inquiries, equipment and software, diagnostics, manuals, records, referrals, and user training. These task descriptions do not approve every drafted term, technical procedure, or professional competence.

source.title: Windows client troubleshooting
source.scope: Overview consulted for identity/access, networking, storage, printing, remote desktop, performance, security, and system management as support categories. Linked detailed procedures were not read. Product-specific features must not be presented as universal to every operating system.

source.title: Phishing scams: how to spot and report them - Report a scam email
source.scope: Page body consulted for suspicious messages, deceptive links, phishing, and appropriate reporting. UK public reporting context only; regional reporting routes are not adopted as universal workplace processes. The lesson must not solicit secrets or teach harmful message handling.

source.title: Preschool Teachers: Occupational Outlook Handbook
source.scope: Selected duties and work-context passages consulted on 16 October 2026. U.S. occupational context, including play, records, and family communication; not a term-frequency ranking, universal qualification standard, or approval of educational methods.

source.title: Childcare Workers: Occupational Outlook Handbook
source.scope: Selected duties and workplace-context passages consulted for everyday care, play, and family communication. U.S. occupational description only; no ratios, care techniques, medication, sleep, feeding, or qualification requirements are adopted as instruction.

source.title: Teacher Assistants: Occupational Outlook Handbook
source.scope: Selected duty passages consulted for supporting teachers, preparing materials, recordkeeping, and school activities. U.S. role descriptions are not universal authorization or a synonym map for every regional role.

source.title: Kindergarten and Elementary School Teachers: Occupational Outlook Handbook
source.scope: Selected duties and context passages consulted for lessons, observation, learning needs, and family communication. The source concerns U.S. occupations, not a universal grade structure or a ranked vocabulary corpus.

source.title: Early years foundation stage
source.scope: The public overview was consulted for areas of learning, play, observation, and its explicit England-only scope. Linked statutory frameworks, exemptions, and assessment requirements were not adopted as universal rules; no age deadline or developmental diagnosis is taught.

source.title: Developmentally Appropriate Practice Position Statement overview
source.publisher: National Association for the Education of Young Children
source.scope: Overview and contents passages consulted for play, individual strengths, family context, and professional areas of responsibility. The complete downloadable statement and linked chapters other than the separately registered assessment and family pages were not reviewed. This is educational context, not curriculum endorsement.

source.title: Observing, Documenting, and Assessing Children's Development and Learning
source.publisher: National Association for the Education of Young Children
source.scope: Selected assessment passages consulted for formative and summative purposes, multiple sources of evidence, context, and limitations. Screening is distinguished from diagnosis; language, cultural context, validity, and family knowledge matter. No diagnostic score, age cutoff, or assessment protocol is supplied.

source.title: Engaging in Reciprocal Partnerships with Families and Fostering Community Connections
source.publisher: National Association for the Education of Young Children
source.scope: Selected family-partnership passages consulted for reciprocal communication, family expertise, strengths, and suitable communication methods. Role authority, guardianship, consent, and local safeguarding duties require separate qualified review. No family composition is treated as a universal norm.

source.title: Keeping children safe in education 2026: part one - overview for all staff
source.scope: The overview displays Updated 1 September 2026 and Applies to England. It explicitly complements rather than replaces the full guidance; the linked full Part One was not consulted. Only safeguarding-role, concern-reporting, information-sharing, and recordkeeping context is used. No reporting deadline, emergency number, investigative procedure, or universal legal entitlement is taught.

source.title: UFLI Teaching Resources Glossary
source.scope: The independent editorial reviewer consulted glossary entries for grapheme, phoneme, phonemic awareness, phonics, morphology, syllable, blending, and segmenting on 16 October 2026. Used for terminology comparison, not curriculum endorsement or approval of every word analysis. Teaching resources and exercises were not copied or acquired.

source.title: IDEA Regulations: Section 300.22, Individualized education program
source.scope: The independent reviewer consulted official search-result excerpts identifying an IEP as a written statement for a child with a disability, with a cross-reference to Section 300.320. Direct page opening returned HTTP 403. No full-text legal review, eligibility determination, required service, timeline, or universal right is claimed. U.S. context only.

source.title: Human Resources Specialists
source.scope: Duties and work-context passages consulted for recruitment, workplace orientation, records, benefits, training, and employee relations. Occupational context only; no employment forecast, qualification threshold, screening authorization, legal entitlement, or term-level dictionary review is adopted.

source.title: 13-1071.00 - Human Resources Specialists
source.scope: Tasks and related work activities consulted for hiring, records, candidate communication, HR systems, staff coordination, and follow-up. Listed activities are occupational descriptions, not permission to conduct checks, testing, investigations, or employment decisions.

source.title: Recruitment: An introduction
source.publisher: Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development
source.scope: Only the public introduction and contents list were read. They describe recruitment in relation to workforce needs and show stages covering role definition, applicants, selection, and appointment. The substantive factsheet is membership-gated and was not read. It is not cited as evidence for a detailed procedure or individual definition.

source.title: Advertising a job - Recruitment
source.scope: Job-description, person-specification, communication, inclusive-advertising, and applicant-information passages consulted. UK-specific employment guidance is not generalized to other jurisdictions. No required advertisement channel, legal test, eligibility check, document demand, or universal entitlement is taught.

source.title: Choosing who to interview - Recruitment
source.scope: Passages on consistent criteria, application information, and selection records consulted. Specific scoring examples and personal/social-media screening guidance are not adopted as a universal hiring method. No advice about a real applicant or employment decision is given.

source.title: Employment information
source.scope: Employment-information landing page consulted for the scope of records, workers' information, and recruitment resources. The recruitment and selection link is explicitly listed under Draft guidance - consultations closed. Linked detailed guidance was not read. No lawful basis, retention duration, health-data rule, or disclosure permission is inferred.

source.title: Compensation, Benefits, and Job Analysis Specialists

source.scope: Selected passage: What are exchange rates?; reference rates. An exchange rate converts between currencies. Published reference rates may differ from actual transaction rates. Limits: Lexical and reference-rate distinction only. No rate, fee, preferred currency or currency-conversion advice is supplied.

source.title: Stripe: Coupons and promotion codes
source.scope: Selected passage: Coupons versus promotion codes; Set a minimum amount. A customer-facing code applies an offer subject to restrictions. A minimum order value can determine whether the code is usable. Limits: The provider's API distinction between coupons and codes is not imposed on ordinary English. No actual discount, minimum amount or automatic entitlement is promised.

source.title: Adyen: Create an authorisation
source.scope: Selected passage: Response authCode field. The response has an authorization code after successful authorization and an empty field when authorization fails. The field is a transaction reference, not a customer PIN. Limits: One API field supports the selected meaning; the code is not proof of capture, settlement or payout. No card data or live processing is involved.

source.title: Adyen: Payments lifecycle
source.scope: Selected passage: Authorization statuses; Capture and settlement statuses. Authorization reserves funds and is distinct from capture and settlement. A refused request is not approved; later statuses must be checked separately. Limits: Provider-specific lifecycle explanation, not operational instructions or a universal status model. No code alone establishes final payment.

source.title: Stripe: Card declines
source.scope: Selected passage: Card declines; Declined card retries. A card issuer may decline an attempted transaction for several reasons. The advice code can prohibit another attempt, so a lesson must not presume retry is appropriate. Limits: Provider-specific evidence for neutral wording. No cause of this fictional decline, retry count, collection advice or authorization to retry is claimed.

source.title: Shopify: Multiple and partial payments on Shopify POS
source.scope: Selected passage: Accept split payment methods for an entire order. One order can be paid using more than one method. The page separately describes partial balances, supporting a distinction from a scheduled installment. Limits: Platform-specific feature with restrictions. No capability, eligibility, procedure or later-payment arrangement is promised for every shop.

source.title: Square: Split a check by item or seat
source.scope: Selected passage: About splitting checks; Split a payment. A single check can be divided into multiple payment amounts when guests pay separately. This supports contributions as well as different payment types. Limits: Restaurant-provider example only. No checkout method, staff permission or universal merchant support is inferred.

source.title: Shopify: Managing Shopify POS receipts
source.scope: Selected passage: Introduction; Send a receipt after a sale. Receipts can be printed or sent electronically. A gift receipt is proof of purchase without the amount spent in this implementation. Limits: Provider-specific availability and regional names remain local to the source. The lesson distinguishes format from gift purpose and asks what is available.

source.title: ACCC: Receipts, bills, proof of purchase
source.scope: Selected passage: Businesses can ask for proof of purchase. Purchase evidence can include a receipt, payment statement or other records linking the buyer and item to the purchase. A receipt is one possible kind of evidence. Limits: Australian guidance only. No evidence sufficiency, mandatory receipt-only policy or universal remedy entitlement is adopted.

source.title: Shopify: Setting up return and cancellation rules
source.scope: Selected passage: Return window. The period and the event that starts it are configurable, and rules can vary by market. The term therefore needs an arrangement-specific definition. Limits: Platform-specific examples only. No duration, start date, fee, exclusion or limit on statutory rights is applied to the lesson.

source.title: GOV.UK: Accepting returns and giving refunds
source.scope: Selected passage: Opening consumer-rights distinction. A seller cannot remove applicable consumer rights through a no-refund statement. Stated store arrangements and legal rights must be kept distinct. Limits: UK guidance illustrates the limitation only. No rule, deadline, entitlement or legal conclusion is generalized to an unspecified jurisdiction.

source.title: FTC: Warranties
source.scope: Selected passage: Introduction; Written Warranties; Spoken Warranties. A product warranty is a seller or manufacturer assurance with specific coverage and limits. Terms can concern repair, replacement or refund; spoken promises are also discussed. Limits: US guidance only. No mandatory coverage, claim process, free remedy or legal right is asserted for a fictional product.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: supply
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun senses 1 and 3. The available-amount sense differs from the act of providing goods. A supply can be adequate, limited or exhausted; coordinating provision does not clearly select an available quantity. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: inventory
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun senses 1, 2 and 3. Inventory can name a list, the goods themselves, or accounting stock including materials and work in progress. The selected goods sense must not be replaced by the list sense in sentences. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: stock
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun supply sense 1. Stock names goods available for sale, with in stock, out of stock and stock checks as ordinary combinations. Financial shares, liquid food and ancestry are separate senses. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: shipment
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun senses 1 and 2. A shipment can be a load of transported goods, distinct from the act of shipping. Incoming selects the direction toward the receiving location. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: purchase order
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition. A purchase order goes from the buying party to the selling party and describes the purchase. This direction distinguishes it from an internal purchasing request. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: backorder
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition and on back order pattern. The noun describes an order for a currently unavailable product. The source uses the open spelling back order; this consultation does not require a spelling migration of the existing closed form. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: lead time
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition. Lead time can span an order to delivery or the start to completion of production. The measured start and end events depend on the process. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: batch
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun senses 1 and 2. A batch is a group handled together; the production sense is an amount made at one time. The group itself differs from the code used to identify it. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: serial number
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition. A serial number identifies a particular product unit. This contrasts with a batch identifier shared across a production group. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: unit
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun business sense 2; separate measurement sense. The business sense is one product item. A measurement unit is a different sense and an incidental occurrence cannot establish a stock-item focus route. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: consignment
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: countable goods sense. The selected noun is a group of goods sent or delivered somewhere. It does not require one vehicle, or mean a consignment-sales ownership agreement. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: replenishment
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition and stock example. The noun names restoring a supply by replacing what has been used. It is a process, not an order document or a quantity by itself. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: expiration date
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun definition and regional label. The phrase covers a stated end of document validity or intended product use; expiration date is labeled North American and expiry date British. It is broader than food safety alone. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: packaging
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun material sense and original packaging combination. Packaging names protective or wrapping materials; original packaging is an attested combination. The materials differ from the process of packaging. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: replacement
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun sense 2 and replacement product combination. The countable sense names a thing supplied in place of another. It does not necessarily imply a new item, identical model, refund entitlement or improved quality. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: faulty
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: adjective product sense 1. Faulty covers things not functioning or made correctly. The project retains its selected functional-defect sense rather than the separate reasoning sense. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: code
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun information-representation sense 1. A code can use letters, numbers or symbols to represent information. A product reference is not necessarily a barcode, secret password or individual serial number. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: size
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: noun clothes/shoes/goods sense 3. Size names standard product measurements; wrong size is an explicit combination. This supports the selected unsuitable-fit or mismatched-dimension phrase. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: wrong
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: adjective sense 4, unsuitable. Wrong can mean unsuitable or different from what is needed, not only factually false or morally bad. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary: damage
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: verb physical-harm sense and damaged participle. Damage includes harm to an object. Damaged packaging describes harmed protective material and does not prove damage to the enclosed product. Limits: Lexical evidence only; no merchant procedure, domain approval, morphology approval, media license or visual/listening approval is implied.

source.title: Shopify: Adjusting inventory quantities
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction, setting new inventory levels, unavailable inventory. The provider records quantity adjustments and their history, distinguishes physical counts from record changes, and separately tracks goods that are held but unavailable. Limits: Provider-specific inventory states and controls; no workflow, authorization, accounting policy or automatic adjustment is imported.

source.title: Shopify: Cycle Counting
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: What is cycle counting?; physical counting versus cycle counting. Cycle counting repeatedly checks selected product groups; a physical count checks actual goods and can expose differences from recorded quantities. Limits: Terminology only. No count frequency, sample size, statistical method or permission to change records is adopted.

source.title: Shopify: Built-in inventory management
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Stay on top of inventory movements with transfers. A transfer moves stock between identified origin and destination locations. The provider distinguishes in-transit goods from receipt at the destination. Limits: Provider example only; no transfer approval or instructions to accept goods are imported.

source.title: Collins English Dictionary: delivery note
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: British English noun definition. A delivery note is a document accompanying delivered goods. The automated illustrative quotations are not relied on. Limits: Dictionary meaning only; no proof-of-receipt, payment or legal acceptance inference.

source.title: DHL Malaysia: Shipment records and document retention
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Difference between a consignment note and a delivery note, checklist passage. The delivery-note passage describes a document between sender and receiver that can list details of the ordered goods. Limits: Only the checklist description is used. The page also reports invoice terminology; that conflation is not adopted. No retention period or contractual effect is imported.

source.title: International Trade Administration: Packing List
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Packing List introduction. A packing list itemizes package contents and can describe quantities, weights and package measurements. Limits: Export-document example only; no required format, customs declaration, attachment practice or legal compliance claim is adopted.

source.title: Oracle Inventory Help: Reorder Point Planning
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Reorder Point Planning introduction. The planning system uses a stock threshold to suggest a replenishment order, with lead time and demand as inputs. Limits: A software planning example only. No formula, threshold, purchase authority or economic recommendation is taught.

source.title: Shopify: Stock Rotation
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Stock rotation definition and seasonal distinction. Stock rotation prioritizes selected goods for sale; arrival order is one method, while seasonal circumstances can also affect the sequence. Limits: No universal rotation method or food-safety clearance is inferred.

source.title: Shopify: First-in, first-out stock rotation
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Definition of the first-in, first-out stock rotation method. The stock-handling method prioritizes earlier received stock for sale or use. The article also discusses a distinct accounting application. Limits: Only physical stock-handling meaning is used. No valuation method, mandatory industry rule, expiry precedence or safety outcome is adopted.

source.title: GOV.UK: Best before and use-by dates
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Date distinction; use-by dates; best before dates. In the UK guidance, use-by labels concern safety and best-before labels concern quality. Both depend on the relevant storage conditions. Limits: UK labeling sense only. No consumption decision, storage temperature, cooking/freezing extension or statutory advice is added to this vocabulary lesson.

source.title: USDA FSIS: Food Product Dating
source.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
source.scope: Consultation method: search_index_passage_direct_fetch_unavailable. Selected passage: Indexed passage on sell-by labeling and inventory management. The indexed official passage describes sell-by as guidance for how long a store displays a product. This supports the retail-display definition without a universal food-safety rule. Limits: Only the search-index passage was available; direct page retrieval failed. No current legal requirement or consumption guidance is asserted.

source.title: GS1 US: What is a GS1-128 barcode?
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction and product-attribute information. Batch/lot information, serial number and expiration date are distinct product data attributes. Together with the batch definition, this supports distinguishing group identifiers from unit identifiers. Limits: No barcode image, code construction, global uniqueness claim for a bare lot code, or compliance procedure is imported.

source.title: Shopify: Using SKUs to manage inventory
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction and creating product/variant identifiers. The source expands SKU as stock keeping unit and uses it for internal product or variant codes. SKUs and barcodes have different functions. Limits: Provider-specific conventions do not establish a global identifier format, required length or one-code-per-unit rule.

source.title: Shopify: Return merchandise authorization
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Definition and What is an RMA number?. A return process can require approval and assign a reference number to an approved return. The reference helps identify the return; it does not by itself guarantee a particular remedy. Limits: Provider explanation only. No universal RMA requirement, return period, packaging condition or override of consumer rights is adopted.

source.title: Shopify: Creating returns and exchanges
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction; return reasons and return-shipping options. The provider distinguishes return reasons, shipping labels, exchange items and financial outcomes. Clothing reasons can include sizes that are too large or too small. Limits: No merchant policy, required customer explanation, refund entitlement, fee rate or instruction to create a return is adopted.

source.title: Shopify: Store credit
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction and customer balance. Store credit gives a customer value to apply to purchases with the issuing store and can be tracked as a balance. It is not necessarily a credit-card loan or a cash refund. Limits: Provider-specific account, channel, expiry and redemption restrictions are not generalized.

source.title: Shopify: Setting up return and cancellation rules
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Restocking fee section. The provider treats a restocking fee as a charge attached to a return, separately from return shipping. It need not be described as proof that the goods will be resold. Limits: A configurable provider charge is not legal permission to impose it. No fee percentage or refund deduction procedure is taught.

source.title: GOV.UK: Accepting returns and giving refunds
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Faulty goods, unwanted goods and distance-sales distinctions. The guidance distinguishes faulty products from change-of-mind returns and contains rights that depend on the circumstances. Packaging can be evidence of purchase rather than a universal condition for a remedy. Limits: Jurisdictional boundary check only. No deadlines, refund guarantees, original-packaging requirement or merchant discretion overriding legal rights is imported.

source.title: Microsoft: Quarantine orders
source.scope: Consultation method: selected_page_passage. Selected passage: Introduction and blocking inventory. The software uses quarantine to separate and block inventory while a quality concern is considered. Held goods are not automatically cleared, discarded or returned. Limits: Software example only; no safety protocol, release criteria, physical segregation standard or authorization is taught.

source.title: Budget Analysts
source.scope: Actual duties consulted for budgets, proposals, funding requests, spending comparisons, forecasts, alternatives and explanation of differences. Occupational context supports original communication drafts only; no funding decision, universal control procedure, or financial recommendation is approved.
